messages:
Nora Blake: Quick sync: planning a micro-launch post + webinar combo to test a two-step activation funnel: launch post -> 10 token instant trial -> short webinar RSVP. want to validate whether a tiny credit nudges people to RSVP.
Evan Li: interesting. what channels for the launch post? blog + product homepage banner + Twitter/X.
Marta Ruiz: also syndicate to partner newsletter. landing page with RSVP + claim token.
Nora Blake: arm ideas:
- control: post + RSVP only
- arm A: post + claim 10-token trial -> RSVP modal shows after claim
- arm B: post + RSVP page shows token claim on confirmation email only

Primary outcome: RSVP rate and % who redeem token before webinar. Secondary: first-5-requests within 48h post-webinar.
Evan Li: tracking events: post_click, rsvp_submitted, token_claimed_micro, redeemed_first_request, webinar_attended.
kenny-bot: note: please add campaign tag "microlaunch-10t" for attribution.
Marta Ruiz: copy options: "Quick demo + 10 free tokens" vs "See Redwood in action (10 tokens included)". split test subject lines and hero CTAs.
Nora Blake: let's run to 10k organic users, split 1/3 control, 1/3 A, 1/3 B. timeframe next Wed. need pixel + GA events and email template by Monday.
Evan Li: routing: signups from enterprise domains -> sales lead, otherwise -> growth nurture. if token redeemed and they hit first-5 -> nudge with premium trial offer in-app.
Marta Ruiz: design ask: hero banner + modal. can we get dark+light variants?
Nora Blake: yes. locking this. post-launch: prepare a benchmark narrative doc with engagement funnel and token economics.
Evan Li: will prototype a small dashboard for RSVP->redeem->first5 funnel.
Marta Ruiz: comment: keep the 10 token size small to measure marginal effect of credit vs bigger bundles.
Nora Blake: cool. I'll post a checklist in #marketing-prod tonight. thanks team.
